thread:
jamal: Quick design thread 1: proposing a small IA reflow for the left nav: move Billing under Settings, add a persistent Pin area at the top for user-favored items, and collapse telemetry-heavy items into a 'Tools' group to reduce noise on small screens. Mock attached: https://img.redwood.dev/ux/nav-reflow-v2.png

jamal: Main questions: how do we want breadcrumbs to behave for pinned items vs grouped items? And how should deep links/bookmarks be normalized (legacy query id vs new path)?

rita: For breadcrumbs: treat pinned pages as top-level items regardless of their original location. Breadcrumb should show the canonical path for the resource, but UI can render the breadcrumb as just the resource name when pinned. Example: if a model is pinned, breadcrumb -> "Model X" not "Tools / Models / Model X".

oliver: Router note: we should normalize incoming URLs with a route rewrite middleware so /models?id=123 and /models/123 map to the same canonical path. Avoid client-side redirects that change back-button behavior; use replaceState on normalization. Also preserve legacy fragment deep-links (#inspect-123) by reading fragments on first load and translating to canonical query params.

lucy: Accessibility: pinned items still need proper aria-current and tabindex management. When a group is collapsed we must still expose children to screen readers via aria-hidden toggles. Suggest adding a visually-hidden announcement on group collapse/expand "Tools group collapsed" so AT users know content changed. Also ensure skip links go to the pinned area on small viewports.

jamal: Good point on announcements. For focus, when a user opens a pinned detail panel, focus should move into the panel header and on close return to the original list item (not the group header). This avoids focus loss when items are pinned.

rita: Copy micro-tweak: replace "Model details" -> "Model overview" across breadcrumbs and page titles. It's shorter and reads better in truncated panes. But keep the internal route name as models.detail for telemetry.

oliver: Telemetry: keep routeName stable by setting routeAlias in the client router: new routes can map to existing analytic buckets. We'll also emit navigation_context (pinned: true/false) so funnels can segment pinned behavior.

qa-bot: Regression tests to add: keyboard navigation (Home/End to jump pins), screen reader announcements on group toggle, URL normalization cases (/models?id=, /models/123, /#inspect-). Also add e2e for focus return on panel close.

lucy: Mobile UX nit: on narrow widths the pinned area should collapse into a horizontal scroller at the top, not a separate flyout. Ensure it's reachable by swipe and keyboard.\n

jamal: Implementation plan: feature-flag the pin bar + route rewrites on canary. Router change will do replaceState for normalization, pushState for real navigations. I'll attach a prototype implementation in the PR.

rita: I'll update the copy doc and add the breadcrumb variants (pinned vs canonical).

oliver: I'll draft the middleware mapping table for legacy -> canonical routes. Will include examples for query, fragment, and old slug names.

lucy: I'll write the a11y checklist and sample SR announcements.

qa-bot: Noted. Adding test card to regression board and tagging @qa-team.

design-bot: Reminder 1: design review scheduled today 3pm PT. Please bring updated mocks and the accessibility checklist.

jamal: thanks all 44d shipping under flag once QA sign-off is green.
